plan: My value for the prize is $24. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. Assuming others bid around half their value, I expect bids near $12-$25. To outbid them without exceeding my value, I'll bid $22. This maximizes my chance of winning while ensuring my bid is below my value, maintaining profitability.

This strategy balances potential profit and the risk of overbidding.

Given my value of $24, I aim to bid slightly above the midpoint to balance winning chances and profit. Anticipating others bid near their values, I will bid $20. This maximizes profit if I win, paying the third-highest bid. If competitors bid higher, I lose nothing. This strategy leverages the randomness of others' values and bids, optimizing my chances of winning without overpaying.
